title: Trust your instincts.
intro: Step into an anonymous room of up to 5 participants. Chat for two minutes, spot who is human and who is a bot, and outscore the other players.
ruleAnonymous: Up to 5 anonymous participants per room — shown only as Player 1 to Player 5, with no names or avatars.
ruleWaiting: A single 3-minute room timer starts on creation. The match begins at 5 participants, when any player presses Start now (at 2–4), or when the timer ends with 2+.
ruleDiscussion: Chat for 120 seconds in discussion, then take 45 seconds to mark each other participant as human or bot (+1 right, −1 wrong).
joinError: We couldn’t join a room right now. Please try again.
alreadyInRoom: You already have an active waiting room. Leave it first to start fresh.
roomClosedNotice: Nobody else joined before the 3-minute timer expired. You can find a new game whenever you’re ready.
waitingNoChat: There is no chat in the waiting room. Discussion opens as soon as the match starts.
startHint: Available with 2–4 participants. The first press starts the room for everyone present.
waitingForSecond: Waiting for at least one more participant before the match can start.
leaveError: We couldn’t leave the room right now. Please try again.
startError: We couldn’t start the match right now. Please try again.
